facts.fact: Romaine 开会时目光扫过空椅子——那是 Kale 的位子。
facts.anchor: My eyes flash to the empty one.

facts.fact: Romaine 对家族理事会谎称计划提前是自己的安排，实际没有准备好说辞。
facts.anchor: “I started the plan early, I did not expect this push back,” I bit out, lying through my teeth.

facts.fact: 刚被发现的无名尸眼睛滴血，而这具尸体不是 Romaine 做的，他需要认领下来。
facts.anchor: That the body that was just found. The one with blood dripping from his eyes.

facts.fact: 十五年半前五家约定动手，阻止 Barley 与 Roux 联姻，杀掉余下的 Barley 家女性。
facts.anchor: To ensure a union could not be had. We would kill the remaining Barley women.

facts.fact: 毒没有按计划扩散，只造成三条人命就已被控制住。
Rondelle 描述无名尸被销毁特征：指纹擦掉、牙齿拔除、脸被砸烂，并问是不是 Romaine 干的。
facts.anchor: “His fingertips were scrubbed off, his teeth removed, his face battered in. Your work?”

facts.fact: Romaine 命令 Scotch 继续监视自己的儿子，随即宣布散会。
facts.anchor: “Your job?” I narrow my eyes. “The same as before. Keep an eye on my son.”

facts.fact: 散会后 Romaine 决定查出无名尸的身份与中毒途径。
facts.anchor: I need to track down who this John Doe is and how exactly he was poisoned.
